movie.title: Comédie-Française
movie.overview: At the Comédie-Française, there is one golden rule: the play is never canceled. Unfortunately for Nina, everything else is—just three hours before the premiere of her first staging. An actor is stuck on a train, tensions explode, equipment breaks down, egos clash, and panic sets in. With no way out and time slipping away, Nina must hold the show together at all costs. Will she make it until the curtain rises?

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When chaos erupts three hours before her directoral debut at the Comédie-Française, Nina must navigate missing actors, breaking equipment, and clashing egos to ensure the show goes on.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: At the prestigious Comédie-Française theater, the unwritten golden rule dictates that no play is ever canceled. Three hours before the premiere of her very first staging, director Nina faces complete catastrophe when key cast members go missing and technical equipment fails. As backstage egos clash and panic spreads through the crew, time rapidly runs out. Nina must deploy every ounce of resourcefulness to hold the production together before the curtain rises.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Nina's dream of directing at the world-renowned Comédie-Française threatens to turn into a nightmare just three hours before opening night. Guided by the institution's sacred rule that a performance is never canceled, she finds herself facing a cascading series of absurd disasters. Her lead actor is stranded on a delayed train, leaving a massive void on stage that no understudy seems prepared to fill. Backstage, fragile egos erupt into full-blown arguments, threatening to destroy the cast's delicate chemistry. To make matters worse, crucial stage equipment malfunctions, throwing the technical crew into a state of blind panic. With every passing minute, the pressure mounts, testing Nina's authority, patience, and sanity. She is forced to mediate ridiculous disputes, improvise last-minute technical fixes, and keep the theater administration at bay. As the clock ticks down toward the final deadline, Nina must rally her dysfunctional company to pull off a miracle. Ultimately, her frantic struggle becomes a testament to the chaotic, resilient spirit of live theater.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set behind the scenes of one of the world's most venerable theater institutions, Comédie-Française follows Nina, a determined young director preparing for the premiere of her debut production. With the theater's strict mandate that the play must go on no matter what, Nina faces the ultimate test when a series of unexpected crises erupts just three hours before showtime. Balancing comedic backstage mishaps with the genuine drama of artistic pressure, the story captures the high-stakes panic, fragile egos, and unrelenting passion required to bring a live performance to life.

story_structure.climax: With moments remaining before showtime and chaos reaching its peak, Nina faces a crucial, make-or-break moment where she must make a final desperate decision to salvage the production.
story_structure.conflict: Just three hours before the curtain rises, disaster strikes when a key actor is stranded on a train and equipment begins breaking down, threatening to ruin the production.
story_structure.resolution: The final outcome unfolds as the deadline arrives, revealing whether Nina's high-stakes efforts were enough to open the doors and honor the theater's ultimate tradition.
story_structure.introduction: Nina, a first-time director at the historic Comédie-Française, prepares for the premiere of her debut play, operating under the theater's strict rule that the show must always go on.
story_structure.risingAction: As the clock ticks down, backstage tensions boil over, egos clash among the cast and crew, and escalating technical chaos pushes Nina to her absolute limits as she fights to keep the team focused.
